name: login-01
title: Login 01
description: A sign-in form in a card, with email and password.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { email, form, FormField, required } from '@angular/forms/signals'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from '@/ui/card/card'; import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, } from '@/ui/form-field/form-field'; import { Input } from '@/ui/input/input'; /** * A sign-in page: a centered card with an email and password form, * validated with Signal Forms, a passkey alternative and a link to sign * up. Errors show once a field has been left, or the form submitted. */ @Component({ selector: 'block-login-01', imports: [ Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FormField, Input, ], template: `

Sign in to your account

Enter your email below to sign in to your account.

@for (error of login.email().errors(); track error.kind) {

{{ error.message }}

}
Forgot your password?
@for (error of login.password().errors(); track error.kind) {

{{ error.message }}

}

Don't have an account? Sign up

`, }) export class Login01Block { protected readonly model = signal({ email: '', password: '' }); protected readonly login = form(this.model, (path) => { required(path.email, { message: 'Enter your email.' }); email(path.email, { message: 'Enter an email like ada@example.com.' }); required(path.password, { message: 'Enter your password.' }); }); /** * Marks the fields touched, so errors show, instead of reloading. * * @param event - The form's submit event. */ protected submit(event: Event): void { event.preventDefault(); this.login().markAsTouched(); } }

docs: Route to it, for example: { path: 'login-01', loadComponent: () => import('./blocks/login-01/login-01').then((m) => m.Login01Block) }
